notes.title: Add chained TRIG POS routing
notes.text: Add chained TRIG POS routing with cycle protection and note ownership, so an older source release cannot cut a newer independent note.

notes.title: Add MULTI ALL/SPLIT/START/TRANS modes, a
notes.text: Add MULTI ALL/SPLIT/START/TRANS modes, a selectable MIDI channel (default 7), panel keyboard input, quantized sequence changes, shared ADSR and portamento. Keep individual arpeggiators in ALL mode and handle overlapping MIDI/panel notes.

notes.title: Add two velocity and two
notes.text: Add two velocity and two keytrack destinations per sound, composed with parameter locks, slides and LFOs without changing stored bases. Generated ARP notes retain the last input key and velocity.

notes.title: Add independent HP/LP keytracking switches.
notes.text: Add independent HP/LP keytracking switches. OFF uses a fixed C4 reference; controller response, envelope/portamento curves and this reference are documented interpretations, not newly measured hardware laws.

notes.title: Preserve full performance settings in
notes.text: Preserve full performance settings in MNM7 projects and version-two full sounds/kits; older records load with disabled/default options. Loading a kit clears performance runtime, and cancelling sound audition restores the full sound.

notes.title: Make mixer level bars readable
notes.text: Make mixer level bars readable with an empty outlined background, solid level fill and the existing peak marker.

notes.title: Isolate RING's rounded multiplies from
notes.text: Isolate RING's rounded multiplies from target load scheduling hazards while preserving its sample arithmetic.

notes.title: All 187 hardware stress cases
notes.text: All 187 hardware stress cases have measurements across two runs. The owner confirmed manually resetting the first run; it is not counted as a firmware failure. Heavy combinations can still exceed the audio deadline.
